card.name: Digits in adverse reaction percentages
card.fires_on: A digit inside a percentage in parentheses, usually the first or second digit after the opening bracket, in a comma-separated list of side effects with rates.

modes.label: Percent in adverse event list
modes.description: A digit inside a percentage that follows a named adverse reaction in a list of reactions with rates.
modes.example: included urinary tract infection (20%), nasopharyngitis (1<<3>>%), upper respiratory tract infection (8%),

modes.label: Number in other parentheses
modes.description: A digit in a measurement in parentheses outside of adverse event lists.
modes.example: as large as 60 centimeters (2<<4>> in) long
